title: Admin order list: newest shipped orders are missing from page 1
author: ops-daniela
body:
In the admin console, filter Shipped, page 1: order #7000 (shipped yesterday) is not there, and neither are the other orders from the last few days. Page 1 starts with much older orders. Going to page 2, 3, ... never shows them either.

Request: `GET /orders?status=shipped&page=1&per_page=20`

The automated tests for this endpoint are green.

comments.author: ops-daniela
comments.body: A colleague says she sometimes sees the same order on two different pages, but I could not reproduce that.
